name: aob_injection
title: Write an AOB code injection
description: Run custom code at an instruction found by signature: generate, check, apply, verify and release. Needs Mcp:EnableAutoAssembler for its gated steps.

arguments.name: instructionAddress
arguments.title: Instruction address
arguments.description: The address of the instruction to hook. A hex address such as 7FF6A1B2C3D0 or a Cheat Engine expression such as game.exe+1A2B.

arguments.name: goal
arguments.title: Goal
arguments.description: What the injected code must achieve, such as double the damage dealt.

arguments.name: symbolName
arguments.title: Symbol name
arguments.description: The symbol name of the injection point, such as damageHook: a letter or underscore, then letters, digits or underscores, 64 characters at most.

name: attach_and_orient
title: Attach to a target and get oriented
description: Start of a session: check versions and capabilities, attach to the authorized process, classify its runtime (native, Mono, IL2CPP, .NET) and suggest the next workflow.

arguments.name: process
arguments.title: Process
arguments.description: The target process name or PID; omit it to choose from the process list.

arguments.name: goal
arguments.title: Goal
arguments.description: What the user wants to achieve, such as infinite health.

name: build_robust_table
title: Build a robust cheat table
description: Turn the address list into a table that survives restarts and updates, test it and save it. Needs Mcp:EnableAutoAssembler for its gated steps.

arguments.name: tablePath
arguments.title: Table path
arguments.description: The absolute .CT path to save, under an allowed table root.

name: call_game_function
title: Call a game function once
description: Run one game function once, such as one that adds gold: find its arguments at a call site, pass numbers or a buffer, call it with consent and verify the effect. Needs Mcp:EnableTargetCodeExecution for its gated steps.

arguments.name: functionAddress
arguments.title: Function address
arguments.description: The entry address of the function. A hex address such as 7FF6A1B2C3D0 or a Cheat Engine expression such as game.exe+1A2B.

arguments.name: purpose
arguments.title: Purpose
arguments.description: What the call must achieve, such as add 1000 gold.

arguments.name: instanceAddress
arguments.title: Instance address
arguments.description: The object whose method it is (this); omit it for a free or static function. A hex address such as 7FF6A1B2C3D0 or a Cheat Engine expression such as game.exe+1A2B.

name: ce_tutorial_walkthrough
title: Cheat Engine tutorial walkthrough
description: Coach one step of CE's tutorial or gtutorial with the matching workflow; a safe way to learn or to smoke-test a setup.

arguments.name: step
arguments.title: Step
arguments.description: The step to coach: 1 to 9 for tutorial, 1 to 3 for gtutorial.

arguments.name: tutorial
arguments.title: Tutorial
arguments.description: tutorial (default, Tutorial-x86_64.exe) or gtutorial (gtutorial-x86_64.exe).

name: cleanup_session
title: Clean up this session
description: End of session or before a target switch: stop jobs, restore and release everything in a safe order and report what remains. Needs Mcp:EnableTargetCodeExecution for its gated steps.

arguments.name: keepAddressList
arguments.title: Keep address list
arguments.description: yes (default) keeps the address-list records; no deletes the records this session created, after asking.

name: compare_snapshots
title: Find what changed in a memory range
description: Which fields of a memory range change when the user does one thing in game: a snapshot before, a comparison after, typed changes and cleanup.

arguments.name: address
arguments.title: Start address
arguments.description: The start of the range. A hex address such as 7FF6A1B2C3D0 or a Cheat Engine expression such as game.exe+1A2B.

arguments.name: size
arguments.title: Size in bytes
arguments.description: How many bytes to snapshot, a decimal number from 1 to 16777216 (default 256).

arguments.name: valueType
arguments.title: Value type
arguments.description: How to read changed slots: int8, uint8, int16, uint16, int32 (default), uint32, int64, uint64, float or double.

arguments.name: description
arguments.title: Action between snapshots
arguments.description: What the user will do between the snapshots, such as take damage.

name: dissect_structure
title: Dissect a structure
description: Name the fields around a base address: RTTI, .NET or PDB layouts or autoguess, then comparison with other instances.

arguments.name: baseAddress
arguments.title: Base address
arguments.description: The object's base address. A hex address such as 7FF6A1B2C3D0 or a Cheat Engine expression such as game.exe+1A2B.

arguments.name: size
arguments.title: Size in bytes
arguments.description: How many bytes to dissect, a decimal number from 1 to 65536 (default 256).

arguments.name: compareWith
arguments.title: Other instances
arguments.description: Other instances' base addresses, separated by commas, to compare with.

name: dotnet_recon
title: Explore a .NET game
description: .NET types, fields, statics and instances through CE's out-of-process .NET collector.

arguments.name: typeName
arguments.title: Type name
arguments.description: The type to find, such as Game.Player.

name: emulator_memory
title: Find values in an emulated console's memory
description: Values inside an emulated console: find the guest RAM base, convert guest addresses and handle big-endian values.

arguments.name: emulator
arguments.title: Emulator
arguments.description: The emulator: dolphin, pcsx2, ppsspp, rpcs3, cemu or other.

arguments.name: guestAddress
arguments.title: Guest address
arguments.description: A guest address from the user's own notes, such as 80001234.

name: engine_triage
title: Identify the game engine and how it stores values
description: Right after attaching, before choosing value types: identify the engine or runtime from modules, exports and version strings, and predict how it stores values.

arguments.name: goal
arguments.title: Goal
arguments.description: What the user wants to find or change, such as the player's gold.

name: explain_error
title: Explain a failure and recover safely
description: After a failed call: explain its error kind and host effect, inspect the state it touched and decide whether a single retry is safe.

arguments.name: kind
arguments.title: Error kind
arguments.description: The error.kind of the failure, such as busy, timeout or capability_disabled.

arguments.name: hostEffect
arguments.title: Host effect
arguments.description: The failure's hostEffect: not_started, not_applied, started, completed, cleanup_unconfirmed or unknown.

arguments.name: tool
arguments.title: Failed tool
arguments.description: The tool that failed, such as memory_write.

name: find_code_by_string
title: Find the code that uses a text
description: A visible message or log line leads to the logic: find the text in the module, the code that references it and the function around that code.

arguments.name: text
arguments.title: Visible text
arguments.description: The exact visible text, case preserved, such as Not enough gold.

arguments.name: module
arguments.title: Module
arguments.description: The module to search, such as game.exe; omit it for the main module.

arguments.name: encoding
arguments.title: Encoding
arguments.description: auto (default) tries UTF-8 and UTF-16; utf8 or utf16 searches one encoding.

name: find_entity_list
title: Find the list that holds entities
description: From one known entity, find the array or list that holds all of them and its count, then anchor it with a pointer path.

arguments.name: entityAddress
arguments.title: Entity address
arguments.description: The base address of one known entity. A hex address such as 7FF6A1B2C3D0 or a Cheat Engine expression such as game.exe+1A2B.

arguments.name: runtime
arguments.title: Runtime
arguments.description: The target's runtime: auto (default), native, mono or dotnet.

arguments.name: expectedCount
arguments.title: Entity count
arguments.description: How many entities the game shows, when known, as a decimal number.

name: find_flag
title: Find a boolean flag or toggle
description: An on/off state such as god mode, a key or an unlocked feature: exact scans while the user toggles it, then its bits and the code that tests it.

arguments.name: state
arguments.title: Current state
arguments.description: The flag's state in game now: on or off.

arguments.name: width
arguments.title: Scan type
arguments.description: The scan type: auto (default: byte, then int32), byte or int32.

arguments.name: description
arguments.title: What the flag controls
arguments.description: What the flag controls, such as god mode.

name: find_float_value
title: Find a floating-point value
description: Floats, doubles, percentages and positions: range scans around the displayed value, then neighbouring fields.

arguments.name: displayedValue
arguments.title: Displayed value
arguments.description: The value the game shows, such as 87.3 or 75%; omit it for a bar without a number.

arguments.name: description
arguments.title: What the value is
arguments.description: What the value is, such as the player's X position.

name: find_known_value
title: Find a known value
description: The value is shown as a number: exact first and next scans, verification one candidate at a time, then a record.

arguments.name: currentValue
arguments.title: Current value
arguments.description: The number the game shows now, such as 100 or 87.5.

arguments.name: valueType
arguments.title: Value type
arguments.description: The scan type: auto (default), byte, int16, int32, int64, float, double, string or wstring. byte is unsigned (-1 is 255); scan an unsigned value above the signed maximum as the signed type of the same width, which util_convert_value computes.

arguments.name: description
arguments.title: What the value is
arguments.description: What the value is, such as player health.

name: find_position
title: Find coordinates and teleport
description: Coordinates to save, restore or teleport in a single-player game: unknown scans while the user moves along one axis, then the neighbouring axes and a verified write.

arguments.name: valueType
arguments.title: Coordinate type
arguments.description: The coordinate type: auto (default; double on UE5, float otherwise), float or double.

arguments.name: address
arguments.title: X coordinate address
arguments.description: The address of the X coordinate, when known, to skip the scan. A hex address such as 7FF6A1B2C3D0 or a Cheat Engine expression such as game.exe+1A2B.

arguments.name: description
arguments.title: Whose position
arguments.description: Whose position it is, such as the player.

name: find_text
title: Find and edit text in memory
description: Text in memory such as a player name or a dialogue buffer: UTF-8 and UTF-16 byte searches, its container and owner, and an in-place edit with consent.

arguments.name: text
arguments.title: Text
arguments.description: The exact text, case preserved, such as the player's name.

arguments.name: encoding
arguments.title: Encoding
arguments.description: auto (default) tries UTF-8 and UTF-16; utf8 or utf16 searches one encoding.

arguments.name: purpose
arguments.title: Purpose
arguments.description: find (default) locates the text; edit also changes it in place, at the same length or shorter.

name: find_timer
title: Find a timer or cooldown
description: A timer or cooldown: scans while it runs and when it is ready, then the code that sets and decrements it, and the remedy.

arguments.name: kind
arguments.title: Timer shape
arguments.description: The timer's shape: countdown, countup, cooldown or unknown (default).

arguments.name: displayedValue
arguments.title: Displayed time
arguments.description: The time the game shows, such as 30, when it shows one.

arguments.name: description
arguments.title: What the timer controls
arguments.description: What the timer controls, such as the dash cooldown.

name: find_unknown_value
title: Find an unknown value
description: Only a bar or a change is visible: an unknown first scan, then increased, decreased, changed and unchanged scans.

arguments.name: valueType
arguments.title: Value type
arguments.description: The value type: auto (default), int32, float or double.

arguments.name: description
arguments.title: What the value is
arguments.description: What the value is, such as the stamina bar.

name: find_writer
title: Find what writes or accesses an address
description: Which instructions write or read an address: a debugger capture job, disassembly and module offsets.

arguments.name: address
arguments.title: Value address
arguments.description: The address of the value. A hex address such as 7FF6A1B2C3D0 or a Cheat Engine expression such as game.exe+1A2B.

arguments.name: trigger
arguments.title: Trigger
arguments.description: write (default) captures writers; access also captures readers.

arguments.name: size
arguments.title: Value size
arguments.description: The value size in bytes: 1, 2, 4 (default) or 8.

name: freeze_value
title: Freeze a value
description: Hold a value constant with an address-list record, verify that the freeze holds and undo it.

arguments.name: address
arguments.title: Value address
arguments.description: The address of the value. A hex address such as 7FF6A1B2C3D0 or a Cheat Engine expression such as game.exe+1A2B.

arguments.name: valueType
arguments.title: Value type
arguments.description: The value type: int8, uint8, int16, uint16, int32, uint32, int64, uint64, float, double, string (UTF-8), wstring (UTF-16) or bytes (a byte array). The prompt shows the matching record_create variableType code.

arguments.name: value
arguments.title: Value to hold
arguments.description: The value to hold, as text or, for bytes, hexadecimal byte pairs such as 90 90; omit it to hold the current value.

arguments.name: description
arguments.title: Record description
arguments.description: The record description, such as Infinite health.

name: group_scan
title: Find an object by several known values
description: Several known values sit at fixed offsets in one object, such as health and ammo: search them as one byte pattern, then narrow and verify.

arguments.name: values
arguments.title: Values and offsets
arguments.description: The values as type:value@hexOffset separated by commas, such as int32:100@0,int32:12@10.

arguments.name: region
arguments.title: Region
arguments.description: heap (default) searches writable private memory; module searches one module; any searches everything.

name: identify_address
title: Explain what is at an address
description: Classify an address as code, static data, a heap object, a stack or an unreadable page, with its symbol, its owners and the next workflow.

arguments.name: address
arguments.title: Address
arguments.description: The address to explain. A hex address such as 7FF6A1B2C3D0 or a Cheat Engine expression such as game.exe+1A2B.

name: injection_copy_base
title: Capture a base pointer by injection
description: Copy the object base an instruction uses into a registered symbol, so records can use [symbol]+offset. Needs Mcp:EnableAutoAssembler for its gated steps.

arguments.name: instructionAddress
arguments.title: Instruction address
arguments.description: The address of an instruction that handles only the player. A hex address such as 7FF6A1B2C3D0 or a Cheat Engine expression such as game.exe+1A2B.

arguments.name: symbolName
arguments.title: Base symbol
arguments.description: The symbol that receives the base (default playerBase): a letter or underscore, then letters, digits or underscores, 60 characters at most, because the injection point is named after it plus Hook.

name: make_aob_signature
title: Make a unique AOB signature
description: A byte pattern that finds an instruction exactly once in its module, with wildcards over bytes that change between builds.

arguments.name: address
arguments.title: Instruction address
arguments.description: The address of the instruction. A hex address such as 7FF6A1B2C3D0 or a Cheat Engine expression such as game.exe+1A2B.

arguments.name: module
arguments.title: Module
arguments.description: The module to search, such as game.exe; omit it for the module that contains the address.

name: manual_pointer_chain
title: Build a pointer chain manually
description: Walk back from the code that accesses a value to a static base, one level at a time, and verify the chain after a restart.

arguments.name: address
arguments.title: Value address
arguments.description: The dynamic address of the value. A hex address such as 7FF6A1B2C3D0 or a Cheat Engine expression such as game.exe+1A2B.

arguments.name: maxLevels
arguments.title: Maximum levels
arguments.description: The most pointer levels to walk: 1 to 8 (default 4).

name: nop_patch
title: Replace code with NOPs
description: Disable an instruction reversibly with a tracked NOP patch, verify it and release it. Needs Mcp:EnableAutoAssembler for its gated steps.

arguments.name: instructionAddress
arguments.title: Instruction address
arguments.description: The address of the instruction. A hex address such as 7FF6A1B2C3D0 or a Cheat Engine expression such as game.exe+1A2B.

name: patch_branch
title: Force or invert a conditional branch
description: A comparison and a conditional jump decide an outcome: force the jump, remove it or invert it with a tracked code patch of the same length. Needs Mcp:EnableAutoAssembler for its gated steps.

arguments.name: address
arguments.title: Jump address
arguments.description: The address of the conditional jump. A hex address such as 7FF6A1B2C3D0 or a Cheat Engine expression such as game.exe+1A2B.

arguments.name: mode
arguments.title: Mode
arguments.description: always makes the jump unconditional, never removes it, invert reverses its condition.

name: plan_cheat
title: Plan a cheat from a goal
description: The user states a goal but not a technique: choose the data or code route for that goal, the workflows to run, how to verify the result and the scope limits.

arguments.name: goal
arguments.title: Cheat goal
arguments.description: The goal: infinite_health, infinite_ammo, currency, one_hit_kill, no_cooldown, teleport, game_speed, toggle_feature, unlock_items or other.

arguments.name: description
arguments.title: Goal in your words
arguments.description: The goal in the user's words, such as never run out of arrows.

name: pointer_scan
title: Find a static pointer with the pointer scanner
description: Pointer map, path scan and rescans across restarts to find a static path to a value.

arguments.name: address
arguments.title: Value address
arguments.description: The dynamic address of the value. A hex address such as 7FF6A1B2C3D0 or a Cheat Engine expression such as game.exe+1A2B.

arguments.name: maxDepth
arguments.title: Maximum depth
arguments.description: The deepest path to search: 1 to 8 (default 5).

arguments.name: maxOffset
arguments.title: Maximum offset
arguments.description: The largest offset per level, a decimal number from 0 to 1048576 (default 4096).

name: repair_after_update
title: Repair a table after a game update
description: A game update broke a record: find the new code, rebuild the signature and offsets, test and save a new table. Needs Mcp:EnableAutoAssembler for its gated steps.

arguments.name: tablePath
arguments.title: Table path
arguments.description: The absolute .CT, .XML or .CETRAINER path of the table, under an allowed table root, when it is not loaded yet.

arguments.name: recordDescription
arguments.title: Broken record
arguments.description: The description of the broken record, such as Infinite ammo.

name: review_aa_script
title: Review an Auto Assembler script before applying it
description: Before applying an Auto Assembler script or enabling a script record: check its syntax, signatures, original bytes and cleanup, without applying it. Needs Mcp:EnableAutoAssembler for its gated steps.

arguments.name: recordId
arguments.title: Record ID
arguments.description: The id of the script record to review; omit it to review the script in the conversation.

arguments.name: site
arguments.title: Injection address
arguments.description: The injection address to compare with. A hex address such as 7FF6A1B2C3D0 or a Cheat Engine expression such as game.exe+1A2B.

name: session_report
title: Report what this session found and changed
description: End of a session or a hand-off, before cleanup: a read-only report of the target, the findings, the changes still applied and what cleanup would release.

arguments.name: detail
arguments.title: Detail
arguments.description: summary (default) or full, which also lists every record, structure and scanner.

arguments.name: tablePath
arguments.title: Table path
arguments.description: The absolute .CT, .XML or .CETRAINER path to save the table to, under an allowed table root; omit it to save nothing.

name: shared_code_filter
title: Filter shared code by entity
description: One instruction serves the player and enemies: find a field that tells them apart and filter the injection on it.

arguments.name: instructionAddress
arguments.title: Instruction address
arguments.description: The address of the shared instruction. A hex address such as 7FF6A1B2C3D0 or a Cheat Engine expression such as game.exe+1A2B.

arguments.name: playerAddress
arguments.title: Player value address
arguments.description: The player's value address, when known. A hex address such as 7FF6A1B2C3D0 or a Cheat Engine expression such as game.exe+1A2B.

name: speedhack
title: Change game speed
description: Change the game speed with CE's speedhack, verify it and restore normal speed. Needs Mcp:EnableTargetCodeExecution for its gated steps.

arguments.name: speed
arguments.title: Speed multiplier
arguments.description: The speed multiplier between 0.01 and 1000, such as 0.5 or 2.

name: trace_logic
title: Trace the logic of an instruction
description: Find the comparison and branch that decide an outcome by reading and tracing the code. Needs Mcp:EnableAutoAssembler for its gated steps.

arguments.name: address
arguments.title: Start address
arguments.description: The address where the logic starts. A hex address such as 7FF6A1B2C3D0 or a Cheat Engine expression such as game.exe+1A2B.

arguments.name: question
arguments.title: Question
arguments.description: The question to answer, such as why the player dies at zero shield.

name: unity_il2cpp_recon
title: Explore a Unity (IL2CPP) game
description: Unity IL2CPP classes and fields: offline from offsets the user supplies, or through CE's data collector after explicit consent. Needs Mcp:EnableTargetCodeExecution for its gated steps.

arguments.name: mode
arguments.title: Mode
arguments.description: offline (default) reads memory only; collector injects CE's data collector into the game.

arguments.name: className
arguments.title: Class name
arguments.description: The class to find, such as PlayerController.

arguments.name: fieldName
arguments.title: Field name
arguments.description: The field to find, such as health.

name: unity_mono_recon
title: Explore a Unity (Mono) game
description: Unity Mono classes, fields, statics and methods through CE's Mono data collector, after explicit consent. Needs Mcp:EnableTargetCodeExecution for its gated steps.

arguments.name: className
arguments.title: Class name
arguments.description: The class to find, such as PlayerController.

arguments.name: fieldName
arguments.title: Field name
arguments.description: The field to find, such as health.

name: unreal_recon
title: Explore a UE4 or UE5 game
description: Unreal Engine 4 or 5 objects and names: the version string, the object header and the name pool, then an anchor for a value found by scanning.

arguments.name: ueVersion
arguments.title: UE version
arguments.description: auto (default) reads the version string; ue4 or ue5 skips that step.

arguments.name: goal
arguments.title: Goal
arguments.description: What the user wants to find, such as the player's health.

name: use_cheat_table
title: Load and use a cheat table
description: Load a table the user trusts, review its scripts, activate one cheat at a time with consent, verify it in game and undo it. Needs Mcp:EnableAutoAssembler for its gated steps.

arguments.name: tablePath
arguments.title: Table path
arguments.description: The absolute .CT, .XML or .CETRAINER path of the table, under an allowed table root; omit it to choose one with table_list_files.

arguments.name: cheat
arguments.title: Cheat to use
arguments.description: The cheat to use, as the table describes it, such as Infinite health; omit it to list the cheats first.

name: write_lua_script
title: Write and run a lua_execute script safely
description: Only when no tool covers a Cheat Engine feature: draft, show and run a bounded Lua script, then report what it left behind. Needs Mcp:EnableUnsafeLua for its gated steps.

arguments.name: purpose
arguments.title: Purpose
arguments.description: What the script must do, such as list the loaded plugins.

arguments.name: effect
arguments.title: Effect
arguments.description: read_only (default) or mutating: whether the script changes the game or Cheat Engine.
